evaluation_type: functional acceptance, not an A/B model benchmark

evals.name: msp-count-free-source
evals.prompt: Use the SPAN landing-page skill on https://share.lakeb2b.com/f/iZ0AciBa/span-msp-landing-us-preview__1_.html. Preserve its offer and source qualifications and deliver a static preview.
evals.expected_output: Source-backed MSP page with the established SPAN hero and footer, optional phone, offer-specific Custom list requirements, illustrative field layout, no invented proof or sent confirmation.
assertions: Builds through the bundled builder with no unresolved tokens.
Omits unsupported stat counters, clients, quantitative comparison, citations and PEO figures.
Gmail and outlook.co.uk are rejected with a visible error; a blank optional phone is accepted on an otherwise valid preview request.
Custom list reveals a labelled custom-requirements field and rejects an empty requirement.
A valid preview request shows nothing was sent and triggers no POST or lead conversion.
All five visual panels are reachable by click and keyboard.
No errors or element overflow at 390, 834 and 1440, with reduced-motion and footer canvas checks.

evals.name: peo-eor-count-backed-regression
evals.prompt: Rebuild the bundled PEO and EOR example with the SPAN landing-page skill without changing its counts or merging its adjustable boards.
evals.expected_output: A generated count-backed preview with the white stat break and separate PEO and EOR bento boards, with no production send behavior.
assertions: Counts reconcile to PEO 223488, EOR 108328 and total 331816.
The stat band has a white background and SPAN Green figures.
Eight tiles appear in each board, with reorder confined to that board and shared pin/ratio feedback.
Provider CTA populates the specific-provider field and keeps required-phone behavior.
Both examples pass boundary tests including inline-script escaping and optional-section omission.
